transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the standard production meeting for the courtyard filmmaker Q&A. We need to cover the approval agenda — microphone setup, recording format, podcast release date, and the two follow-up status-report commitments — before I can sign off and we open the courtyard to guests. Let's begin with the oral status round. Could the sound and rights leads please report on their respective areas?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue for the microphone setup. I completed an RF survey of the courtyard after soundcheck and found that wireless microphones are unreliable there due to interference from the neighboring broadcast compound. The Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones instead. My survey report is still awaiting upload to the production folder — I'll get that uploaded as a follow-up.
